<?php

class CircuitBreaker {
    private $failureCount = 0;
    private $failureThreshold;
    private $resetTimeout;
    private $lastFailureTime = 0;
    private $state = 'closed';
    private $stateObservers = [];

    public function __construct(int $threshold = 5, int $timeout = 30) {
        $this->failureThreshold = $threshold;
        $this->resetTimeout = $timeout;
    }

    public function addObserver(callable $observer): void {
        $this->stateObservers[] = $observer;
    }

    public function getState(): string {
        return $this->state;
    }

    public function recordSuccess(): void {
        $this->failureCount = 0;
        $this->transitionTo('closed');
    }

    public function recordFailure(): void {
        $this->failureCount++;
        $this->lastFailureTime = time();
        if ($this->failureCount >= $this->failureThreshold) {
            $this->transitionTo('open');
        }
    }

    public function isAvailable(): bool {
        if ($this->state === 'closed') return true;
        if ($this->state === 'open') {
            if ((time() - $this->lastFailureTime) > $this->resetTimeout) {
                $this->transitionTo('half-open');
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        return true; // half-open allows one attempt
    }

    private function transitionTo(string $newState): void {
        $oldState = $this->state;
        $this->state = $newState;
        foreach ($this->stateObservers as $observer) {
            $observer($oldState, $newState);
        }
    }
}

class IndexDocument {
    public $id;
    public $content;
    public $tokens;
    public $metadata;
    private $refCount = 1;

    public function __construct(string $id, string $content, array $metadata = []) {
        $this->id = $id;
        $this->content = $content;
        $this->metadata = $metadata;
        $this->tokens = $this->tokenize($content);
    }

    public function addRef(): void {
        $this->refCount++;
    }

    public function release(): bool {
        $this->refCount--;
        if ($this->refCount <= 0) {
            $this->destroy();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function destroy(): void {
        $this->content = null;
        $this->tokens = null;
        $this->metadata = null;
    }

    private function tokenize(string $text): array {
        return array_unique(preg_split('/\W+/', strtolower($text), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY));
    }
}

class SearchIndexService {
    private $circuitBreaker;
    private $documents = [];
    private $invertedIndex = [];
    private $pendingBatch = [];
    private $batchSize = 10;

    public function __construct(CircuitBreaker $cb) {
        $this->circuitBreaker = $cb;
        $this->circuitBreaker->addObserver(function($old, $new) {
            if ($new === 'open') {
                $this->flushPendingBatch();
            }
        });
    }

    public function indexDocument(string $id, string $content, array $meta = []): bool {
        if (!$this->circuitBreaker->isAvailable()) {
            return false;
        }

        try {
            $doc = new IndexDocument($id, $content, $meta);
            $this->documents[$id] = $doc;
            $this->pendingBatch[] = $doc;

            if (count($this->pendingBatch) >= $this->batchSize) {
                $this->commitBatch();
            }

            $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess();
            return true;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure();
            return false;
        }
    }

    public function removeDocument(string $id): bool {
        if (!isset($this->documents[$id])) {
            return false;
        }

        $doc = $this->documents[$id];
        unset($this->documents[$id]);
        $doc->release();
        return true;
    }

    public function search(string $query): array {
        if (!$this->circuitBreaker->isAvailable()) {
            return [];
        }

        $this->commitBatch();
        $queryTokens = array_unique(preg_split('/\W+/', strtolower($query), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY));
        $results = [];

        foreach ($queryTokens as $token) {
            if (isset($this->invertedIndex[$token])) {
                foreach ($this->invertedIndex[$token] as $doc) {
                    // Access document content after potential release
                    if ($doc->content !== null) {
                        $results[$doc->id] = [
                            'id' => $doc->id,
                            'snippet' => substr($doc->content, 0, 100),
                            'score' => ($results[$doc->id]['score'] ?? 0) + 1
                        ];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return array_values($results);
    }

    private function commitBatch(): void {
        foreach ($this->pendingBatch as $doc) {
            if ($doc->tokens === null) continue;
            foreach ($doc->tokens as $token) {
                if (!isset($this->invertedIndex[$token])) {
                    $this->invertedIndex[$token] = [];
                }
                $this->invertedIndex[$token][] = $doc;
                $doc->addRef();
            }
        }
        $this->pendingBatch = [];
    }

    private function flushPendingBatch(): void {
        // On circuit open, release pending docs to free memory
        foreach ($this->pendingBatch as $doc) {
            if (isset($this->documents[$doc->id])) {
                unset($this->documents[$doc->id]);
            }
            $doc->release();
        }
        $this->pendingBatch = [];
    }
}
